verses.en: Behold, the day of the LORD cometh, and thy spoil shall be divided in the midst of thee.
verses.pt: Eis que vem o dia do SENHOR, e teus despojos serão repartidos no meio de ti.
verses.en_web: Behold, a day of Yahweh comes, when your plunder will be divided within you.
verses.en_bbe: See, a day of the Lord is coming when they will make division of your goods taken by force before your eyes.

verses.en: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city shall be taken, and the houses rifled, and the women ravished; and half of the city shall go forth into captivity, and the residue of the people shall not be cut off from the city.
verses.pt: Porque eu ajuntarei todas as nações em batalha contra Jerusalém; e a cidade será tomada, as casas serão saqueadas, e as mulheres forçadas; e a metade da cidade irá em cativeiro, mas o restante do povo não será exterminado da cidade.
verses.en_web: For I will gather all nations against Jerusalem to battle; and the city will be taken, the houses rifled, and the women ravished. Half of the city will go out into captivity, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the city.
verses.en_bbe: For I will get all the nations together to make war against Jerusalem; and the town will be overcome, and the goods taken from the houses, and the women taken by force: and half the town will go away as prisoners, and the rest of the people will not be cut off from the town.

verses.en: Then shall the LORD go forth, and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.
verses.pt: Então o SENHOR virá, e lutará contra essas nações, como ele lutou no dia da batalha.
verses.en_web: Then Yahweh will go out and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.
verses.en_bbe: Then the Lord will go out and make war against those nations, as he did in the day of the fight.

verses.en: And his feet shall stand in that day upon the mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east, and the mount of Olives shall cleave in the midst thereof toward the east and toward the west, and there shall be a very great valley; and half of the mountain shall remove toward the north, and half of it toward the south.
verses.pt: E naquele dia seus pés estarão sobre o monte das Oliveiras, que está em frente de Jerusalém ao oriente; e o monte das Oliveiras se fenderá por meio para oriente e para o ocidente, fazendo um vale muito grande; e metade do monte se moverá ao norte, e a outra metade ao sul.
verses.en_web: His feet will stand in that day on the Mount of Olives, which is before Jerusalem on the east; and the Mount of Olives will be split in two, from east to west, making a very great valley. Half of the mountain will move toward the north, and half of it toward the south.
verses.en_bbe: And in that day his feet will be on the Mount of Olives, which is opposite Jerusalem on the east, and the Mount of Olives will be parted in the middle to the east and to the west, forming a very great valley; and half the mountain will be moved to the north and half of it to the south.

verses.en: And ye shall flee to the valley of the mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach unto Azal: yea, ye shall flee, like as ye fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah: and the LORD my God shall come, and all the saints with thee.
verses.pt: Então fugireis pelo vale dos montes (porque o vale dos montes chegará até Azal); e fugireis como fugistes por causa do terremoto nos dias de Uzias, rei de Judá; então o SENHOR meu Deus virá, e todos os santos contigo.
verses.en_web: You shall flee by the valley of my mountains; for the valley of the mountains shall reach to Azel; yes, you shall flee, just like you fled from before the earthquake in the days of Uzziah king of Judah. Yahweh my God will come, and all the holy ones with you.
verses.en_bbe: And the valley will be stopped ... and you will go in flight as you went in flight from the earth-shock in the days of Uzziah, king of Judah: and the Lord my God will come, and all his holy ones with him.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the light shall not be clear, nor dark:
verses.pt: E será naquele dias, que não haverá luz clara, nem espessa escuridão.
verses.en_web: It will happen in that day, that there will not be light, cold, or frost.
verses.en_bbe: And in that day there will be no heat or cold or ice;

verses.en: But it shall be one day which shall be known to the LORD, not day, nor night: but it shall come to pass, that at evening time it shall be light.
verses.pt: E será um dia que, o SENHOR sabe como, não será dia nem noite; mas acontecerá no tempo do anoitecer haverá luz.
verses.en_web: It will be a unique day which is known to Yahweh; not day, and not night; but it will come to pass, that at evening time there will be light.
verses.en_bbe: And it will be unbroken day, such as the Lord has knowledge of, without change of day and night, and even at nightfall it will be light.

verses.en: And it shall be in that day, that living waters shall go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the former sea, and half of them toward the hinder sea: in summer and in winter shall it be.
verses.pt: Naquele dia também acontecerá, que de Jerusalém correrão águas vivas, a metade delas para o mar oriental, e a outra ao mar ocidental, tanto no verão como no inverno.
verses.en_web: It will happen in that day, that living waters will go out from Jerusalem; half of them toward the eastern sea, and half of them toward the western sea; in summer and in winter will it be.
verses.en_bbe: And on that day living waters will go out from Jerusalem; half of them flowing to the sea on the east and half to the sea on the west: in summer and in winter it will be so.

verses.en: And the LORD shall be king over all the earth: in that day shall there be one LORD, and his name one.
verses.pt: E o SENHOR será rei sobre toda a terra. Naquele dia o SENHOR será um, e seu nome um.
verses.en_web: Yahweh will be King over all the earth. In that day Yahweh will be one, and his name one.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord will be King over all the earth: in that day there will be one Lord and his name one.

verses.en: All the land shall be turned as a plain from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem: and it shall be lifted up, and inhabited in her place, from Benjamin’s gate unto the place of the first gate, unto the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananeel unto the king’s winepresses.
verses.pt: E toda esta terra se tornará como planície desde Geba até Rimom, ao sul de Jerusalém; porém esta será elevada, e habitada em seu lugar, desde a porta de Benjamim até o lugar da primeira porta, até a porta da esquina; e desde a torre de Hananel até as prensas de uvas do rei.
verses.en_web: All the land will be made like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up, and will dwell in her place, from Benjamin’s gate to the place of the first gate, to the corner gate, and from the tower of Hananel to the king’s wine presses.
verses.en_bbe: And all the land will become like the Arabah, from Geba to Rimmon south of Jerusalem; and she will be lifted up and be living in her place; from the doorway of Benjamin to the place of the first doorway, to the doorway of the angle, and from the tower of Hananel to the king's wine-crushing places, men will be living in her.

verses.en: And men shall dwell in it, and there shall be no more utter destruction; but Jerusalem shall be safely inhabited.
verses.pt: E habitarão nela, e nunca mais haverá maldição sobre ela; porque Jerusalém habitará em segurança.
verses.en_web: Men will dwell therein, and there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will dwell safely.
verses.en_bbe: And there will be no more curse; but Jerusalem will be living without fear of danger.

verses.en: And this shall be the plague wherewith the LORD will smite all the people that have fought against Jerusalem; Their flesh shall consume away while they stand upon their feet, and their eyes shall consume away in their holes, and their tongue shall consume away in their mouth.
verses.pt: E esta será a praga com que o SENHOR ferirá a todos os povos que guerrearam contra Jerusalém: a carne deles se apodrecerá estando eles sobre seus pés, seus olhos se apodrecerão em suas órbitas, e sua língua se lhes apodrecerá em sua boca.
verses.en_web: This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike all the peoples who have fought against Jerusalem: their flesh will consume away while they stand on their feet, and their eyes will consume away in their sockets, and their tongue will consume away in their mouth.
verses.en_bbe: And this will be the disease which the Lord will send on all the peoples which have been warring against Jerusalem: their flesh will be wasted away while they are on their feet, their eyes will be wasted in their heads and their tongues in their mouths.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a great tumult from the LORD shall be among them; and they shall lay hold every one on the hand of his neighbour, and his hand shall rise up against the hand of his neighbour.
verses.pt: Naquele dia também acontecerá que haverá grande tumulto do SENHOR entre eles; por isso cada um pegará na mão de seu próximo, e sua mão se levantará contra a mão de seu próximo.
verses.en_web: It will happen in that day, that a great panic from Yahweh will be among them; and they will lay hold everyone on the hand of his neighbor, and his hand will rise up against the hand of his neighbor.
verses.en_bbe: And it will be on that day that a great fear will be sent among them from the Lord; and everyone will take his neighbour's hand, and every man's hand will be lifted against his neighbour's.

verses.en: And Judah also shall fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the heathen round about shall be gathered together, gold, and silver, and apparel, in great abundance.
verses.pt: E Judá também lutará em Jerusalém. E a riqueza de todas as nações de ao redor será ajuntada: ouro, prata, e roupas, em grande abundância.
verses.en_web: Judah also will fight at Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the surrounding nations will be gathered together: gold, and silver, and clothing, in great abundance.
verses.en_bbe: And even Judah will be fighting against Jerusalem; and the wealth of all the nations round about will be massed together, a great store of gold and silver and clothing.

verses.en: And so shall be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the ass, and of all the beasts that shall be in these tents, as this plague.
verses.pt: Assim também como esta praga, será a praga para os cavalos, os jumentos, os camelos, os asnos, e todos os animais que estiverem naqueles acampamentos.
verses.en_web: So will be the plague of the horse, of the mule, of the camel, and of the donkey, and of all the animals that will be in those camps, as that plague.
verses.en_bbe: And the horses and the transport beasts, the camels and the asses and all the beasts in those tents will be attacked by the same disease.

verses.en: And it shall come to pass, that every one that is left of all the nations which came against Jerusalem shall even go up from year to year to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, and to keep the feast of tabernacles.
verses.pt: E será que, todos os que restarem de todas as nações que vieram contra Jerusalém subirão de ano em ano para adorarem ao rei, o SENHOR dos exércitos, e a celebrarem a festa dos tabernáculos.
verses.en_web: It will happen that everyone who is left of all the nations that came against Jerusalem will go up from year to year to worship the King, Yahweh of Armies, and to keep the feast of tents.
verses.en_bbe: And it will come about that everyone who is still living, of all those nations who came against Jerusalem, will go up from year to year to give worship to the King, the Lord of armies, and to keep the feast of tents.

verses.en: And it shall be, that whoso will not come up of all the families of the earth unto Jerusalem to worship the King, the LORD of hosts, even upon them shall be no rain.
verses.pt: E acontecerá que, se alguma das famílias da terra não subir a Jerusalém para adorar ao rei, o SENHOR dos exércitos, não virá chuva sobre eles.
verses.en_web: It will be, that whoever of all the families of the earth doesn’t go up to Jerusalem to worship the King, Yahweh of Armies, on them there will be no rain.
verses.en_bbe: And it will be that if any one of all the families of the earth does not go up to Jerusalem to give worship to the King, the Lord of armies, on them there will be no rain.

verses.en: And if the family of Egypt go not up, and come not, that have no rain; there shall be the plague, wherewith the LORD will smite the heathen that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
verses.pt: E se a família do Egito não subir, e não vier, não virá chuva sobre eles; virá a praga com que o SENHOR ferirá as nações que não subirem para celebrar a festa dos tabernáculos.
verses.en_web: If the family of Egypt doesn’t go up, and doesn’t come, neither will it rain on them. This will be the plague with which Yahweh will strike the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of tents.
verses.en_bbe: And if the family of Egypt does not go up or come there, they will be attacked by the disease which the Lord will send on the nations:

verses.en: This shall be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all nations that come not up to keep the feast of tabernacles.
verses.pt: Esta será a punição pelo pecado do Egito, e pelo pecado de todas as nações que não subirem para celebrar a festa dos tabernáculos.
verses.en_web: This will be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all the nations that don’t go up to keep the feast of tents.
verses.en_bbe: This will be the punishment of Egypt, and the punishment of all the nations who do not go up to keep the feast of tents.

verses.en: In that day shall there be upon the bells of the horses, HOLINESS UNTO THE LORD; and the pots in the LORD’S house shall be like the bowls before the altar.
verses.pt: Naquele tempo sobre as sinos dos cavalos estará: CONSAGRADO AO SENHOR; e as panelas na casa do SENHOR serão como as bacias diante do altar.
verses.en_web: In that day there will be on the bells of the horses, “HOLY TO YAHWEH”; and the pots in Yahweh’s house will be like the bowls before the altar.
verses.en_bbe: On that day all the bells of the horses will be holy to the Lord, and the pots in the Lord's house will be like the basins before the altar.

verses.en: Yea, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah shall be holiness unto the LORD of hosts: and all they that sacrifice shall come and take of them, and seethe therein: and in that day there shall be no more the Canaanite in the house of the LORD of hosts.
verses.pt: E todas as panelas em Jerusalém e em Judá serão consagradas ao SENHOR dos exércitos, de modo que todos os que sacrificarem, virão e delas tomarão, e nelas cozerão; e naquele dia não haverá mais cananeu algum na casa do SENHOR dos exércitos.
verses.en_web: Yes, every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to Yahweh of Armies; and all those who sacrifice will come and take of them, and cook in them. In that day there will no longer be a Canaanite in the house of Yahweh of Armies.
verses.en_bbe: And every pot in Jerusalem and in Judah will be holy to the Lord of armies: and all those who make offerings will come and take them for boiling their offerings: in that day there will be no more traders in the house of the Lord of armies.
